detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic drama, vertical 9:16, warm skin against cool window light, shallow depth of field, natural motion. No graphics or embedded subtitles.
[Shot 1] 00:00–00:02.300. Daughter's eye-level medium-wide POV entering through the opening office door. The door edge sweeps out of foreground as the camera advances one short step, revealing <Subject 1> behind his desk at screen left and <Subject 2> seated in a single guest chair at screen right. <Subject 2> stops turning a pen and looks up toward the arriving daughter; his jaw is initially set. The camera slows as she stops. Door latch, one footstep, quiet cloth movement; no vocalization.
At 00:02.300, cut to [Shot 2] 00:02.300–00:11.500. Eye-level medium view from the daughter's position: <Subject 1> is foreground left and <Subject 2> in the right background. <Subject 1>'s stern look warms when he sees his daughter. He opens one hand toward her and turns his eyes to <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> (S1), a mature warm French-accented voice, speaks conversational English without rushing: <d>[English] Sir, this is my daughter, and she is my only heir. She is very beautiful, isn't she?</d> His gesture happens during the introduction. The camera slides gently thirty centimeters to the right during the line, bringing <Subject 2>'s attentive eyes into clearer view without crossing the eyeline. Only <Subject 1>'s lips move during the line. <Subject 2> listens, gradually shifting his attention from the father to the daughter. No additional speech.
At 00:11.500, cut to [Shot 3] 00:11.500–00:15.000. Close view of <Subject 2> from the daughter's standing eye level. He briefly looks from her face downward and returns to her eyes; his jaw relaxes and the corner of his mouth lifts into a restrained, unexpectedly soft smile. A slow twenty-centimeter push-in ends on his green eyes and the smile by 00:14.000. He remains seated, hands still; no new dialogue or consequential action. Hold the same look through the source tail. The intended edit ends at 00:14.000 on this unanswered attraction.
